invite.subject: You've been enrolled in {planName}
invite.heading: Your membership is ready
invite.action: Register or log in with this email address — {email} — and your membership benefits appear automatically.
invite.note: Your benefits only apply once you are signed in with that address. There is nothing to redeem and no code to enter.

confirmed.subject: Your {planName} membership is active
confirmed.heading: Your membership is active
confirmed.lead: Your {planName} membership ({levelName}) is now linked to this account.
confirmed.action: Your member prices are applied automatically when you book while signed in.

claim.subject: Confirm your {planName} membership claim
claim.heading: Confirm your membership
claim.lead: Someone signed in as {requesterEmail} asked to add your {planName} membership ({levelName}) to their account.
claim.action: If that was you, confirm below. The link works once and expires in 24 hours.
claim.note: If it was not you, ignore this email. Nothing changes and your membership stays where it is.

exhausted.subject: You've used your last included consultation
exhausted.heading: Your included consultations are used up
exhausted.lead: You have now used all {allocated} included consultations on your {planName} membership ({levelName}) for this term.
exhausted.onwardsPercent: From now on you get {fallbackPercent}% off these consultations instead.
exhausted.onwardsFixed: From now on these consultations cost you {fallbackPrice}.
exhausted.onwardsNone: From now on these consultations are charged at the standard price.
exhausted.action: Nothing else changes — the rest of your membership benefits are unaffected, and the price is always shown before you pay.

card.benefitAllowanceShared: {count} included {subject}, shared with your primary member

welcome.subject: Your {planName} membership card
welcome.heading: Welcome to {planName}
welcome.lead: Your {planName} membership ({levelName}) is set up. Your card is attached to this email.
welcome.dependentIdLine: Your membership number is {membershipId}, on the family membership of {primaryMembershipId}.
welcome.sharedNote: Included consultations are shared across your family membership, so the number above is the allowance for the membership as a whole rather than for you alone.
welcome.termsLine: These are the benefits as they stand today. The current terms for your membership always live in the member portal — check there before you book.
welcome.action: Your member prices are applied automatically when you book while signed in with this address.
